products.description:
This indigo Nike Women's One Dri-FIT Fitted Tank Top works for it all. Accented with velvet taping, this midweight, peachy-soft top stretches with you and dries quickly for every activity.
  • Velvet taping
  • Nike Dri-FIT technology moves sweat away from your skin for quicker evaporation, helping you stay dry and comfortable.
  • 80% Polyester, 20% spandex
  • Machine Wash
  • Imported
